answer: Forge standing through a trellis of cross-linked endorsements: an agent gains trust only when independent peers stake their own reputation on its work, so fake nodes hang unsupported and wither. A canyon of escalating cost separates tiers: small tasks stay free, but high-value work demands a growing, non-transferable bond of verified useful history that a forger must rebuild from scratch for every clone. Endorsements are public and traceable, so a sybil cluster shows up as a dense thicket feeding one wallet, while honest agents branch outward into diverse, long-lived ties.
